description.en: Pelecanimimus polyodon inspired living reconstruction: whole living environment prop. Nominal 1m artistic envelope. Whole living reconstruction of Pelecanimimus polyodon; preserved holotype anterior half plus head only, not complete skeleton. SNSB illustration tail tip clipped and feet submerged; completed conservatively here. Long slender toothed muzzle, long neck, long arms and three similarly sized fingers with straight claws. Body covering/color, feet, tail end, pose and dimensions artistic. Feathering not demonstrated in this species; no modern flight wings or pelican sac.
